author: MiniMadScientist
body: In my opinion Avicore, although it has good programming, was not a good update. The new maps are hard to get used to, I want to like them but I can't. Nexus and Avicade coming back does not mean that Nebula can be changed completely. I never get to play my favourite maps, Nebula is so full of new ones. I don't like how rendezvous is at night and in my personal opinion as an Avic I think that Avicore was unfortunately not worth waiting for.
